gloss: as stated above; the above; aforementioned

definitions.gloss: as stated above; the above; aforementioned
definitions.explanation: A formal written expression meaning "as described above" or "the foregoing." Used in legal documents, academic papers, and formal reports to refer back to previously stated content.

examples.japanese: {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The request is rejected for the reasons stated above.

examples.japanese: {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧、{本件|ほんけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As stated above, this matter has been approved.

examples.japanese: {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づき→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧、⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{損害賠償|そんがいばいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Based on the aforementioned facts, the defendant is hereby ordered to pay damages.

notes:
Composed of {如|じょ} (like, as) and ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (above). A formal written expression found in legal texts, official documents, and academic writing. Rarely used in spoken Japanese or informal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: as stated above
- {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: for the above reasons
- {如上|じょじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: the aforementioned facts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: the above; that is all — more common and versatile
- ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧: the above-mentioned — commonly used in business writing
- ⟦{前述|ぜんじゅつ}→前述：11911_zenjutsu⟧: aforementioned — used in academic and formal contexts
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧: the above (in vertical writing) — traditional legal/formal usage
